name: FINAL FANTASY TACTICS - The Ivalice Chronicles

achievements.name: Mandalia Plains
achievements.detail: Win the cadets' battle on Mandalia Plains.

achievements.name: Change Jobs
achievements.detail: Give a fighter a new job in town and take that class into battle.

achievements.name: Chapter One
achievements.detail: Clear the fortress battle that ends Ramza's first chapter.

achievements.name: Agrias Joins
achievements.detail: Fight beside Agrias Oaks and recruit the holy knight.

achievements.name: Mustadio Joins
achievements.detail: Help Mustadio Bunansa in Goug and add the engineer to your roster.

achievements.name: Master a Job
achievements.detail: Raise one job to its highest rank so its skills can move to other classes.

achievements.name: Riovanes Duel
achievements.detail: Win the solo duel against Wiegraf in Riovanes Castle Keep.

achievements.name: Arithmetician
achievements.detail: Unlock the Arithmetician job and cast one of its spells in battle.

achievements.name: Cloud Joins
achievements.detail: Finish the side quest that lets Cloud fight in your battles.

achievements.name: Thunder God
achievements.detail: Free Cidolfus Orlandeau and recruit the Thunder God.

achievements.name: Genji Gear
achievements.detail: Take a piece of Genji equipment from a late battle and equip it.

achievements.name: War Concluded
achievements.detail: Win the final battle and carry the chronicle through to its end.
